title: bet.resettled
description: A settled bet's settlement changed (C10 §5-6): a result was withdrawn (status open) or corrected (a new settlement). Published by the settlement module on NATS subject evt.bet.resettled (version 1). Consumers: C13, C14 (BET_RESETTLED). This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. Every amount is in santim and every number is the bet's own (slipcalc's quote of its legs' results under its rules version). Ids only, no personal data. New fields are additive only.

rules_version.description: The tenant config version whose rules priced and settle the bet (C16 §6)

stake_santim.description: The stake charged (D1.3: a remainder isn't)

settlement_version.description: The new settlement's version, or the withdrawn one's when the bet is open again

ledger_txn_ids.description: The reversals of the withdrawn settlement, then the new postings

status.description: open: a result was withdrawn and the bet waits for a new one ("result under review"); otherwise its new settlement

outcome.description: partial: paid, but a leg lost or half-lost

payout_santim.description: Paid to the player in all: the quote's net payout, accumulator bonus and stake-tax refund included (0 for a loss)

acca_bonus_santim.description: Paid by its own ACCA_BONUS from HOUSE_BONUS_COST (C11)

previous_payout_santim.description: What the withdrawn settlement had paid; its transactions are reversed, and what the player's cash couldn't cover is owed (settlement.clawback_created)
